biotools.summary: The CFSAN SNP Pipeline 2 (CSP2) is a bioinformatics pipeline designed for rapid and accurate SNP distance estimation from bacterial genome assemblies. Written in Nextflow and Python, it leverages MUMmer alignment and parallel processing to efficiently analyze large clusters of bacterial pathogens.
